description: Search the postgres source at any commit (or across history) in the code-history index: every line of every commit, byte-exact. Literal by default; match=regex (PostgreSQL regex, ^ $ per line, \b \< \> as grep), match=identifier (snake_case/CamelCase/UPPER spellings). File sets equal `git grep -l` there. Results name the sha and ref. complete=false: totals are lower bounds (cut says why). history (all | <rev> | A..B): every matching line any commit there had, with the commits that added and removed it.

commit.description: SHA (7+ hex), branch, tag (REL_17_0), major (17, 9.6), release (17.2), <ref>@YYYY-MM-DD (its last commit that day), <ref>~N or commit URL. Default: the newest release branch

history.description: Search history: all, a rev (up to it on its line) or A..B (as git log A..B)

output.description: lines (default), files (with counts) or counts ([path, count])

name: code_search
